The '''RPS-6 rocket launcher''' was manufactured by [[Merr-Sonn Munitions, Inc./Legends|Merr-Sonn Munitions, Inc.]] and used by both the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] as a portable guided/unguided anti-vehicle weapon.

==Description==
[[File:ThiresBrightIdea-Ambush.png|thumb|left|200px|[[Thire/Legends|CC-4477]] prepares to fire an RPS-6 on Rugosa]]
The RPS-6 [[Missile launcher/Legends|rocket launcher]] was produced by [[Merr-Sonn Munitions, Inc./Legends|Merr-Sonn Munitions, Inc.]] during the time of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. The rocket was capable of destroying vehicles protected by [[Ray shield/Legends|ray shields]], but were ineffective against [[Umbaran mobile heavy cannon/Legends|Umbaran mobile heavy cannons]].<ref name="General">{{TCW|The General (episode)}}</ref>

==History==
The RPS-6 was used by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="Ambush">{{TCW|Ambush}}</ref> The [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|Royal Naboo Security Forces]] on the planet [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] also used the launcher during that time period. [[Chrin]] fired one at a droid patrol.<ref name="Valley" />

During the [[Battle of Umbara/Legends|Battle of Umbara]], members of the [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]] carried the RPS-6 and fired them against [[Umbaran militia]] vehicles in a frontal assault against an [[Umbaran airbase/Legends|airbase]].<ref name="General" />

[[Rex/Legends|CT-7567]] used one to [[Battle of Kiros|destroy]] an [[Armored Assault Tank/Legends|Armored Assault Tank]] on [[Kiros/Legends|Kiros]].<ref name="TCW:K">{{TCW|Kidnapped}}</ref>

Later on in the war, [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] paid [[Hondo Ohnaka/Legends|Hondo Ohnaka]] to gun-run a supply of the latest RPS-6s to the [[Onderon rebels/Legends|rebels]] on [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]]. They were successfully fired against a quartet of [[HMP droid gunship/Legends|Heavy Missile Platform droid gunships]].<ref name="TCW:TP" />

Clone troopers carried three during the [[Invasion of Scipio/Legends|invasion of Scipio]]. They were used against [[Hyena-class bomber/Legends|''Hyena''-class bombers]].<ref name="Crisis">{{TCW|Crisis at the Heart}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The RPS-6 appears in the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' multimedia project.
